story.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman apologizes to Tumbler Ridge over failure to alert police before mass shooting
story.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman issued a public letter to residents of Tumbler Ridge, Canada, expressing deep regret that his company did not alert law enforcement about a suspect who later carried out a mass shooting. The incident has reignited urgent debate about whether AI companies bear a duty of care when their systems surface evidence of imminent danger. The apology marks one of the most significant public admissions of responsibility by a frontier AI lab over real-world harm.
